trello.name: Fix and verify Android photo upload crash
trello.desc: Marcus will fix the NullPointerException crash in the media picker callback on Android 14 related to photo uploads being backgrounded mid-upload. The fix must be completed and verified by Wednesday to allow QA time before the August 20 mobile release. Sam will confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices and include it in the regression test run.

trello.name: Implement offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Elena will build the backend sync API this sprint to support offline mode for the notes list, implementing last-write-wins conflict resolution without merge UI. Marcus will implement the client-side local cache in Room, queue writes when offline, and replay them when back online. Acceptance criteria: the app must allow opening in airplane mode to view and edit notes, with full reconciliation and no data loss upon reconnecting. Marcus will write these criteria into the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam will finish migrating the test and release pipelines to GitHub Actions this sprint, maintaining the nightly build schedule. Both Jenkins and GitHub Actions will run in parallel for one week before decommissioning Jenkins. Priya approved this plan but requires Jenkins to remain active during the parallel run.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting and metrics to search endpoint
trello.desc: Elena will add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint, limiting users to 100 requests per minute and returning HTTP 429 with Retry-After headers when limits are exceeded. She will also add a metrics counter to monitor user request rates.

trello.name: Update privacy policy screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Marcus will update the privacy policy screen for the August 20 release to meet GDPR requirements. The new screen will have opt-in consent with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, with no pre-checked boxes. Marcus will obtain the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen accordingly.

trello.name: Write regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Sam will write regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths. These tests will run in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
